blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — LeBron James and Joel Embiid were among the healthy inactives for the Philadelphia 76ers in their preseason opener Monday night against the NBA champion New York Knicks. All-Star guard Tyrese Maxey also sat out. Jaylen Brown and VJ Edgecombe were the lone regular starters in the lineup. Brown, who was acquired by Philadelphia in a trade for Paul George, only played in the first half and led the 76ers’ 120-97 win with 22 points on 8-of-13 shooting from the field.
